title: Data agent inside Fabric ask question on your Business Central Data
summary: Data Agents in Microsoft Fabric enable users to ask natural language questions about Business Central data without using APIs. The feature works with Mirrored Data sources for near real-time data synchronization and can be integrated into Copilot Studio for enhanced user experience.
key_points: Fabric Data Agents answer natural language questions on Business Central data already stored in Fabric, without API calls
Mirrored data sources synced with bc2adls give near real-time data
Keep tables at 100 columns or fewer, or answer quality drops
Agent instructions let it join tables, for example Customer Ledger Entries with Customer to group by City
Querying Fabric instead of the MCP server or APIs keeps load off Business Central users, and the agent can be added to Copilot Studio
features: Natural language queries on Business Central data

quotes.text: you can really easy create AI applications with your data and ask questions on your data
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the primary capability: using natural language to query Business Central data without technical complexity

quotes.text: if there is an huge demand of request your Business Central users won't affect it
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the performance benefit of querying Fabric data instead of directly calling Business Central APIs
